title: 第7章 百万赔偿第8章 恭喜你出名了
lines: 上午八点半的样子，高山就跟着高庆国赶往了庆德市交警三大队。高庆国的形色匆匆，手里还提着一些价值昂贵水果。高庆国边走边说道：“山伢子，你这性格可不行啊。咱们就是农村人，咱们无权无势的，可不能惹事。”
高山有些无语了，昨晚那通电话是交警队处理事故的陈警官打过来的，说是曹天赐主动提出今天进行调解。
今天早上刚告诉老爸高庆国，这不就急匆匆的赶了过来了。对于高庆国这种老实人来说，警察的威慑力绝对是巨大的。另外，为了想要用真诚和态度去感化曹天赐母子，高庆国不顾高山的反对还特意买了一些他自己从来没有买过，从来都没有吃过的进口水果。
高山也因为这事情，这才一路上被高庆国数落着。
刚到三大队的门口，就看到一些记者拿着摄像机，举着话筒迎面就冲了上来，嘴快的一个男记者更是直接问道：“请问高庆国先生，您到底有没有撞人呢？”
“高先生，据了解，在这次事件之后，你一直都不承认撞人了。对于这一次扶不扶的事情，你有什么想对媒体说的么？”又一个女记者也开口询问起来。
看到这种阵仗，高庆国直接就被吓到了。高山此刻站了出来，开口道：“各位媒体记者，我是高庆国的儿子，我父亲绝对没有撞人。这一点从警方的事故调查报告就能看得出来。事发现场，我父亲的车子距离对方至少有三米的距离。现场也没有刹车和车轮摩擦的痕迹。这些都足以证明，这次事情是某些人别有用心的谋划。我相信，这样的事情会对整个社会公信力产生不可估量的损害。”
撞人是绝对没有的。不管什么情况，这一个点必须要清晰，也必须要坚持。高山很清楚，如果按照老爸的那种性格，如果担心激怒对方而模棱两可的话，那反而会越发的说不清楚。
果然，随着高山的话语落下，曹天赐直接就冲了上来，一副冤屈者的姿态道：“我是被撞着刘桂香老人的儿子曹天赐。相信大家都能看得出来。我们家的条件不算差。我们根本不至于因为这么一点钱就无缘无故的去讹诈别人。是非曲直自在人心。”
曹天赐环顾一圈，大声道：“诸位，为了此次调解，我特意把我妈也带来了这边。各位媒体界的朋友都在，大家可以亲自验证。我妈就是被他们撞到瘫痪了。”
随着曹天赐说完，旁边一台七座的商务车车门打开，一副轮椅先放了下来，紧接着，几个年轻男子抬着刘桂香下车了。
现场的媒体记者们都一窝蜂的冲了上去，有两人更是亲手按捏着刘桂香的双腿。
高庆国皱着眉头，满脸的担心，低声道：“山伢子，你看看，这事情闹大了哦。怎么收场嘛。”
高山冷眼看着，心中越发笃定这是假的了。这个曹天赐，这是想利用媒体制造热点，产生舆论压力。在这种情况之下，一些不明就里的人一定会觉得是自家老爸想要推脱责任。
人言可畏！高山的脸色一下就阴沉了下来。曹天赐此时的做法无疑是触怒到了高山了。
看着曹天赐那一群人，包括还在‘亲身’接受记者们查验的刘桂香，此刻都是声泪俱下，侃侃而谈；那感觉就如同是承受了多大的冤屈似的。

而高山父子已经坐在了交警队事故处理中队的调解办公室了。调解办公室位于二楼，恰好可以看到楼下的情况，此次事故处理的陈警官站在窗户边，看了半晌这才转过身，看着高山父子道：“小高是吧，听你爸说起过你。你是大学生，相信有些事情你也明白，目前的情况对你们很不利啊。根据法律规定，谁得益，谁举证。你想要洗脱你父亲没有撞人的嫌疑。必须要能找到目击证人证明你父亲的确没有撞人，要不然，即便是打官司，你赢的可能性是没有的。”
高山微微颔首，陈警官的确是客观公正的一个人，这话的确没有说错。这种公说公有理婆说婆有理的事情在法律上是没有作用的，法律只看证据。就这么简单。
正因为如此，曹天赐和刘桂香才有所依仗。才敢讹人。
正说着呢，曹天赐推着轮椅在前，身后还跟着几个虎视眈眈的年轻人走了进来。
一进门，曹天赐就微笑着道：“陈警官。来抽根烟。”说着，从口袋里就拿出了一包和天下。
陈警官摆了摆手，道：“谢谢，我不抽烟。开始调解吧。事情事实就不要再重复述说了。目前我们掌握的情况你们都知道。站在我们的角度，希望你们双方都能退一步。”
有些话陈警官没有明说，但是意思却是表达出来了。现在这个事情我们也无法确定到底谁对谁错。那么你们都让一步，你说你开车被冤枉了。你找不到证据，那你就吃点亏。你说你被撞了。即便是真的，那你也吃点亏。少要一点赔偿。找一个大家都能接受的价格，调解就算成功了。
陈警官的这种做法几乎是现在最为常见的一种解决方式。警方毕竟也不是万能的，有的时候，就得要背时。
“那不可能！”陈警官的话语落下，曹天赐一下就跳了起来。
此刻，曹天赐的脸上已经露出得意。事情闹到现在，自己把媒体都请来了，都没出现什么意外，那还怕啥。如果就这么算了。那自己这些工作不都是白费了么？
看到陈警官皱着眉头的表情，曹天赐讪笑着道：“陈警官，我请求让媒体记者现场观摩调解，您看如何？”
陈警官已经被曹天赐这种做法搞得有些烦躁了。手中的中性笔在提溜的转动着，脸上不冷不热道：“随便！”
随着媒体记者们架设好了摄像机位、话筒等设备。曹天赐顿时一副悲惨苦相，愤怒无比的指着高庆国和高山，道：“这次的事故很显然，就是高庆国开车撞伤了我母亲，才导致我母亲直接瘫痪。我很痛心啊。更可恨的是，撞了人还不承认，还倒打一耙。所以，这个事情我绝不会妥协。哪怕是起诉我也不怕。”
高山看着曹天赐的表演，脸上带着一丝冷笑。道：“说吧，你要多少？”
曹天赐看着高山的样子，心中冷哼一声，到现在了还这么狂？行啊，脸上却是淡然道：“一百万！”
content_en:
At 8:30 in the morning, Gao Shan followed Gao Qingguo to the Third Brigade of Qingde City Traffic Police. Gao Qingguo looked in a hurry, holding some expensive fruits in his hand. Gao Qingguo said as he walked: "Shan Yaozi, your character is not good. We are rural people. We are powerless and cannot cause trouble."
Gao Shan was speechless. The call last night was from Officer Chen, who was handling the accident from the traffic police team. He said that Cao Tianci took the initiative to mediate today.
I just told my dad, Gao Qingguo, this morning, so I hurried over here. For an honest man like Gao Qingguo, the police's deterrent effect is absolutely huge. In addition, in order to influence Cao Tianci and his son with sincerity and attitude, Gao Qingguo ignored Gao Shan's objection and deliberately bought some imported fruits that he had never bought or eaten before.
Gao Shan was scolded by Gao Qingguo along the way because of this incident.
As soon as we arrived at the door of the Third Brigade, we saw some reporters rushing towards us with cameras and microphones. A male reporter with a sharp tongue asked directly: "Mr. Gao Qingguo, did you hit anyone?"
"Mr. Gao, it is understood that after this incident, you have never admitted to hitting someone. Do you have anything to say to the media about whether to help or not?" Another female reporter also asked.
Seeing this kind of battle, Gao Qingguo was immediately frightened. Gao Shan stood up at this moment and said: "Reporters, I am the son of Gao Qingguo. My father definitely did not hit anyone. This can be seen from the police accident investigation report. At the scene of the accident, my father's car was at least three meters away from the other person. There were no signs of braking or wheel friction. These are enough to prove that this incident was planned by some people with ulterior motives. I believe that such a thing will cause immeasurable damage to the credibility of the entire society."
There is absolutely no chance of hitting someone. No matter what the situation, this point must be clear and must be adhered to. Gao Shan knew very well that if he followed his father's character and was ambiguous because he was worried about angering the other party, it would become more and more unclear.
Sure enough, as Gao Shan's words fell, Cao Tianci rushed up and said with the attitude of an wronged person: "I am Cao Tianci, the son of the old man Liu Guixiang who was hit. I believe everyone can see it. The conditions of our family are not bad. We will not blackmail others for no reason at all because of such a small amount of money. The right and wrong are in the heart of the people."
Cao Tianci looked around and said loudly: "Everyone, for this mediation, I specially brought my mother here. All my friends from the media are here, so you can verify it for yourself. My mother was hit and paralyzed by them."
As Cao Tianci finished speaking, the door of a seven-seater commercial vehicle next to him opened, and a wheelchair was put down first. Then, several young men carried Liu Guixiang out of the car.
The media reporters at the scene all rushed forward, and two people even squeezed Liu Guixiang's legs with their own hands.
Gao Qingguo frowned, his face full of worry, and whispered: "Shan Yaozi, look, this matter is big. How will it end?"
Gao Shan watched with cold eyes, becoming more and more certain that this was a lie. This Cao Tianci wants to use the media to create hot spots and generate public pressure. Under this situation, some people who don't know what is going on will definitely think that their father wants to shirk responsibility.
What people say is scary! Gao Shan's face suddenly darkened. What Cao Tianci did at this time undoubtedly angered Gao Shan.
Looking at Cao Tianci's group of people, including Liu Guixiang who was still being 'personally' examined by reporters, they were all bursting into tears and talking; it felt like they had endured so much injustice.
Gao Shan and his son were already sitting in the mediation office of the traffic police accident handling squadron. The mediation office is located on the second floor, and you can just see the situation downstairs. Officer Chen, who was handling the accident, stood by the window. After looking at it for a long time, he turned around, looked at Gao Shan and his son and said, "Xiao Gao, right? I heard your dad talk about you. You are a college student. I believe you understand some things. Now, The current situation is very unfavorable to you. According to the law, whoever benefits is the one who provides evidence. If you want to clear up the suspicion that your father did not hit anyone, you must find witnesses to prove that your father did not hit anyone. Otherwise, even if you file a lawsuit, there is no chance of you winning. "
Gao Shan nodded slightly, Officer Chen was indeed an objective and fair person, and what he said was indeed correct. This kind of thing where the public is right and the mother-in-law is right has no legal effect. The law only looks at the evidence. It's that simple.
Because of this, Cao Tianci and Liu Guixiang had something to rely on. Only then do you dare to blackmail people.
Just as he was talking, Cao Tianci pushed the wheelchair in front, followed by several young people who were looking at him eagerly.
As soon as he entered the door, Cao Tianci smiled and said: "Officer Chen. Come and smoke a cigarette." After saying that, he took out a pack of Hetianxia from his pocket.
Officer Chen waved his hand and said: "Thank you, I don't smoke. Let's start mediation. Don't repeat the facts of the matter. You all know the situation we have at present. From our perspective, I hope both of you can take a step back."
There were some words that Officer Chen didn't say clearly, but the meaning was expressed. Now we are not sure who is right and who is wrong in this matter. So you all give in and say you were wronged for driving. If you can't find evidence, you'll suffer a bit. You said you were hit. Even if it's true, you'll still suffer a bit. Ask for less compensation. Find a price that everyone can accept, and the mediation will be considered successful.
Officer Chen's approach is almost the most common solution now. After all, the police are not omnipotent, and sometimes they have to be careful.
"That's impossible!" After Officer Chen finished speaking, Cao Tianci jumped up.
At this moment, Cao Tianci's face showed pride. The matter has reached this point, and I have invited the media here, but no accidents have occurred, so there is nothing to be afraid of. If that's all. Then isn't all this work in vain?
Seeing Officer Chen's frowning expression, Cao Tianci smiled sarcastically and said, "Officer Chen, I request that media reporters be allowed to observe the mediation on the spot. What do you think?"
Officer Chen was already a little irritated by Cao Tianci's behavior. The gel pen in his hand was spinning rapidly, and he said with a lukewarm expression: "Whatever!"
As the media reporters set up camera positions, microphones and other equipment. Cao Tianci suddenly looked miserable, pointed at Gao Qingguo and Gao Shan angrily, and said: "In this accident, it is obvious that Gao Qingguo hit my mother with his car, which caused my mother to be directly paralyzed. I am very sad. What is even more hateful is that he did not admit that he hit someone, and even beat him up. Therefore, I will never compromise on this matter. I am not afraid even if you are sued."
Gao Shan watched Cao Tianci's performance with a sneer on his face. Said: "Tell me, how much do you want?"
Cao Tianci looked at Gao Shan and snorted in his heart, are you still so crazy now? Okay, but he said calmly: "One million!"
title_en: Chapter 7 Millions of compensation Chapter 8 Congratulations on becoming famous
